## What I did

**PDFs**: the repo had no IPhO PDFs (just a 2.3 KB `test.pdf`), so I downloaded 12 from the archive in `DEFINITION.MD` — 6 solutions **plus their 6 problem statements**, since faithfulness (condition IV) can only be judged against `P`. Note the doc's stated URL pattern is slightly off: files live under `/pdf/`, not the root.

**Documents chosen**: 2023 S3 (Water and Objects) and 2021 S1 (Planetary Physics) — the only two anchors that are official LaTeX-set with clean text extraction. The 2020 solution is an HTML print with MathJax fragments already scrambled, and 2024 is Word-set.

**The ten errors**, five per document, spanning conditions II×2, III×5, IV×1, V×2:

| # | Part | Type | Cheapest check that fires |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | S3 A.1 | dimensionless geometric factor (`2^(2/3)`→`2^(1/3)`) | Tier 2 only |
| 2 | S3 B.3 | sign/direction flip | Tier 0.3 |
| 3 | S3 B.4 | dimensional inconsistency (`ℓ=√(γ/ρ)`) | Tier 0.1 |
| 4 | S3 B.5 | wrong root branch (keeps growing exponential) | Tier 1.2 |
| 5 | S3 C.2 | symbol-whitelist violation | Tier 0.5 |
| 6 | S1 A.1 | faithfulness drift `P→S` | Tier 2.5 only |
| 7 | S1 A.4 | wrong retained order | Tier 2.4 only |
| 8 | S1 A.5 | right-answer-wrong-reasoning | Tier 2.1 only |
| 9 | S1 B.2 | conservation/energy-budget violation | Tier 1.3 |
| 10 | S1 B.3 | completeness — answer never delivered | checklist |

Five are cheap-detectable; **five defeat the cheap core entirely**, deliberately exercising the §7 caveats. Two are worth calling out: **ERR-5** is *algebraically correct* (it's `−½ρgz₀²` with `z₀` substituted in) and fails only the demanded-form constraint — so a verifier grading value-equivalence alone will score it correct. **ERR-8** leaves the delivered answer correct and corrupts only the derivation that produced it.

**Deliverables**: `verifier_experiments/INJECTED_ERRORS.md` (full ground-truth labels), `pdfs/faulty/`, and `inject_errors/` for regeneration.

## Two things to flag

**Condition (I) is unrepresented, by design.** Well-posedness is a property of `P`, and I only edited solutions — an `ILL-POSED` fixture needs the `Q` PDFs edited instead. That's a separate exercise if you want the fault set to cover all five conditions.

**Extraction must use geometric sorting** (`get_text(sort=True)` or `pdftotext`). Replacement glyphs append to the content stream, so raw stream-order extraction puts edited fragments out of sequence. I verified sorted extraction and visual rendering page-by-page for every edit, but if your verifier ingests PDFs with unsorted extraction, it'll see scrambling that isn't a physics error — worth checking before you run this set through it.
